Name: Pottery Studio
Author: CaptainWolfe11
Description:
This mod adds two new clay types you can hunt for and mix yourself, and the ability to craft your own dishes, mugs, cups, and sculptures! Robin will help you build your own pottery studio, and then the rest is up to you. Each basic stoneware and porcelain pot can be decorated with 22 different glazes and fired in the big kiln in your studio. Unglazed pots can be fired in an electric kiln, and earthenware pots can be fired in an outdoor pit. Your pots count as artisan goods, too!

This mod doesn't conflict with Sylvarmyst's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29890]PFM Pottery Kiln, updated for 1.6 [/url]by Syanide23. Their pots are made in a different, more streamlined fashion, and the designs look great, so go check it out!

[u]Some Tips:[/u]

-Each pot takes 1 day to fire completely﻿
-Crafting recipes are linked to your mining level, and higher levels will yield better clay
-To get a complete glazed pot, you must 1) throw the pot on the wheel, 2) fire it in the electric kiln, 3) glaze it at the glazing station, and 4) fire it in the stone kiln

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hDqEN2n.png[/img]

Download the file from this mod page and unzip it using a software like 7zip or Unarchiver, or the Windows 'extract' feature. Drop it into the 'Mods' folder, in the same folder your Stardew Valley game is found. If you need more help, this is a great resource: [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started[/url]﻿


[img]https://i.imgur.com/odaDxFm.png[/img]﻿

This mod has an i18n file for translations, and translators are welcome, no permission required! If you let me know when you upload your i18n file, I'll link to it here.

In the optional files you will find the i18n file for a Korean translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/jjongleee]jjongleee[/url] - thank you so much for translating!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bia4GtR.png[/img]


I want to extend thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], without which I would not be able to make mods for Stardew! Also, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/EscaMMC]EscaMMC[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/HimeTarts]HimeTarts[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Wildflourmods]Wildflour[/url] for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]tilesheets[/url] which were inspiring to work with :)

As for the machines and pots created for this mod, people are free to use them in other Stardew Valley mods or to make retextures of them (I know my pixel art could use some work lol)
